up: Count the number of IC50 activity records grouped by the assay organism. Join the activities and assays tables on assay_id. Filter the activities to only include those where standard_type is 'IC50'. Group by assays.assay_organism. Return the organism name and the count of activity records. Exclude any entries where the organism name is NULL or an empty string.
sql: SELECT a.assay_organism, COUNT(*) AS count_of_records FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.assay_organism IS NOT NULL AND a.assay_organism != '' GROUP BY a.assay_organism
